reasonCodeDescription: Point of Interaction Error / Duplicate Processing

statement.disputeReason: 4834 - Point of Interaction Error / Duplicate Processing
statement.detailedDescription: The cardholder's statement shows two charges of $79.99 each from 'PHONESHIELD PRO' on the same day. The cardholder states they only made one purchase and the second is a duplicate.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: The cardholder emailed PhoneShield Pro [3 days after the charges]. The merchant replied that both are separate orders but the cardholder doesn't recall placing two.
statement.requestedResolution: Reversal of one $79.99 charge as a duplicate.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.riskAssessment: Medium — merchant may have valid defense documentation.
bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4834 (Point of Interaction Error / Duplicate Processing).
